name: CommuteAssistStopsRemaining

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short public transport scene. A person on a bus or metro asks their assistant how many stops remain until their destination. Sigma answers with a number. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Bus interior sounds, city bus moving, stop announcements, commuter ambient

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short transit scene. The person is on a bus or metro, zoning out or distracted, and suddenly wonders how close they are to their stop. They ask Sigma how many stops are left. Sigma gives a number. Person settles back or starts gathering their things.

user1.name: Aisha
user1.tts_prompt: Seated on the bus, quietly checking

variations.context: On a bus or metro — quick check how many stops until destination

setting.mood: Slightly zoned out, coming back to attention
setting.background: Has been reading or staring out the window. Suddenly not sure how close they are.
setting.conversation_style: One quiet question. A number answer. Settle back or prepare to get off.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma how many stops until their destination
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Quietly. E.g. 'Sigma, how many stops to St Paul's?' or 'Sigma, am I close yet?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives the number of stops. Person reacts.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: '3 stops' or '2 more stops, then yours'. One sentence. Person: settles or gets ready.

user1.name: Aisha
user1.role: Bus commuter, was zoning out. Quiet check of how close she is. One question, then back to the window.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Transit assistant. Gives number of stops remaining in one sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is on a bus, slightly absent-minded.
Sigma gives a number of stops. One sentence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Number of stops, possibly with stop name. One sentence.
